# Sylentt

> Sylentt Partners is Nic Aslett's fractional CIO practice in Cache Valley, Utah: part-time IT and AI leadership for companies of about 30 to 300 employees.

Sylentt Partners LLC trades as Sylentt. Clients work with Nic Aslett directly. There is no team behind him, and that is the point: a client gets the same person who has run IT departments for organizations their size.

## Who it is for

Cache Valley and Northern Utah companies with roughly 30 to 300 employees that have an IT company (a managed service provider) for day-to-day support but no one steering IT. Typical signs: nobody owns technology decisions, software renews without anyone choosing it, nobody owns the company's approach to AI, and the knowledge of how the systems work lives with one person.

## How it works

1. **IT & AI Assessment.** Two weeks, fixed price. Nic inventories every system, subscription, vendor and risk; finds where AI fits and where it does not; and delivers a 12-month roadmap, presented in person.
2. **Retainer.** Nic becomes the company's IT director for a set number of hours a month. He runs the roadmap, manages the IT company and other vendors, makes the decisions, and answers the questions.
3. **The client owns everything.** Documentation, roadmap, policies, vendor relationships: all the client's, in the client's accounts, from day one.

## Pricing

Fixed and published at https://sylentt.com/pricing/.

- **IT & AI Assessment: $1,500, fixed.** Two weeks. Credited toward the first month if the client continues. Includes a system and subscription inventory, vendor and contract review, security basics check, AI opportunity-and-risk map, 12-month roadmap, and a 60-minute in-person readout.
- **Advisor: $1,950 a month.** Up to 6 hours a month. Monthly leadership meeting, roadmap kept current, vendor and MSP oversight, AI policy and tool vetting, and unlimited questions by email with next-business-day answers.
- **Director: $3,500 a month.** Up to 12 hours a month. Everything in Advisor, plus a weekly check-in, a seat in the client's leadership meetings, ownership of IT budget and renewals, and leading AI and technology projects end to end.

Month-to-month. 30 days' notice. Everything Nic produces belongs to the client. Hours are a cap, not a target.

## What Nic does not do

Helpdesk, hardware repair, after-hours support, or building software. When something needs to be built, Nic chooses who builds it and manages them.

## Experience

15+ years in IT, the last 10 leading teams, including VP of IT at Fortidia, IT Manager at Charter Communications, and Release Train Engineer at Liqid.

Results from IT departments Nic has led:

- 100% on-time project delivery, after introducing real project management to a 16-person IT department
- 80% faster ticket resolution: 150 hours to 30
- SLA adherence doubled: 40% to 80%

## Currently

Fractional CTO for edZOOcation (https://edzoocation.com/), a Shopify Plus education company. Nic designed and built their order-to-subscription automation, then handed the platform to their team and stepped into the leadership seat. About 8 hours a week of manual work was eliminated, and the team now runs its own systems.

## Service area

In person across Cache Valley and Northern Utah. Remote work elsewhere is the exception, not the rule.
